name: A raw plate
prompt: A plate comes back raw in the middle. The owner holds it up at the pass and asks whose it was. It was {name}'s.

outcome.told: Nobody answers. The owner puts it back on the grill herself and looks at you both.
The owner tells you to watch your temperatures. {name} doesn't look up, but at close says thanks.
The owner takes it to {name}. Neither of them says anything to you.
